text: dsh-desktop-pet（DSH 网页客户端插件）：在输入框附近放置会回应当前会话的鲸鱼或像素螃蟹。它把宠物绘制在页面浮层，并读取会话运行、等待确认、完成、错误和 token 用量来更新状态。宠物可拖动、互动、旅行并生成明信片，也提供设置页、状态卡和日记。适合想让 DSH 会话状态更直观、增添轻量陪伴体验的用户。状态与设置保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，不需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-desktop-pet adds a whale or pixel crab beside the DSH composer. It reflects session activity and token usage, and offers draggable interaction, a status card, diary, and appearance settings. State stays in browser localStorage; no key or external service is needed.

Show me when an agent is working, waiting for approval, or done.

Add a draggable whale or pixel crab beside the composer.
dsh-desktop-pet 的功能「会话状态回应」：工作、等待确认、完成和错误状态会触发宠物反馈；插件订阅当前会话状态并转成宠物事件。 通过会话订阅、宠物交互或设置页触发，结果显示在 DSH 页面中。
dsh-desktop-pet 的功能「按 token 计食」：每轮 assistant 消息的输入与输出 token 会累加为宠物的食物计数，缓存读取量不计入。 通过会话订阅、宠物交互或设置页触发，结果显示在 DSH 页面中。
dsh-desktop-pet 的功能「拖动与停靠」：宠物可在窗口内拖动；输入框出现时可自动停靠在输入框上沿，也可停在自选位置。 通过会话订阅、宠物交互或设置页触发，结果显示在 DSH 页面中。
dsh-desktop-pet 的功能「本地状态与设置」：宠物状态和配置写入浏览器 localStorage，设置可切换角色、大小、配色、提醒及爱心特效。 通过会话订阅、宠物交互或设置页触发，结果显示在 DSH 页面中。
dsh-desktop-pet 使用浏览器 localStorage 保存宠物状态和设置；这些数据按代码路径保存在当前浏览器环境中，换设备不会同步。

dsh-desktop-pet README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/Kris8888888/dsh-desktop-pet.git
```

Or install it from the plugin market inside DSH. Settings → Desktop Pet has the switches.

dsh-desktop-pet README · What it does：- **Reacts to the current session**: works while the agent runs, rings a bell when a tool call waits for your approval (click it to jump to that session), plants a flag when a turn finishes, shows a red dot on errors.
- **Eats tokens**: every finished turn feeds it `inputTokens + outputTokens` (cache reads don't count). It gets hungry, sleepy and sick over time.
- **Right-click menu**: feed a snack (3 a day), medicine when sick, pet it, send it travelling (it comes back 40–120 minutes later with a postcard), status card, diary.
- **Perches on the input box**, following it when the page changes; with no input box on screen it stands in the bottom-right corner. **Drag it** anywhere inside the window and it stays there; drop it near the input box to perch again.
- **Settings**: whale or crab, four sizes, three colour skins per character, reminders (noon, long sitting, end of day, late night) and heart effects.
dsh-desktop-pet README · What it does：State and diary live in the browser's `localStorage`; nothing is sent anywhere.

dsh-desktop-pet README · Desktop edition (optional, macOS / Windows)：The plugin above draws the pet inside the DSH window. There is also a floating edition that sits on the outer top edge of the DSH window, gripping it with its fins, and can be dragged onto the desktop. A plugin can't open windows of its own, so that edition patches the installed DSH app (`app.asar`) with an install script — read [docs/desktop-edition.md](docs/desktop-edition.md) before using it. When it's installed, this plugin hands its settings and session events to the floating pet instead of drawing a second one.

dsh-desktop-pet README · Development：- `lib/` — client source; `tools/build.mjs` bundles it into `client.js` (no dependencies).
- `sprites/` — whale poses cut from the design sheets in `docs/whale-assets/` by `tools/cut_sprites.py`, inlined into `client.js` at build time.
- `pet/` + `tools/install.sh`, `tools/install-windows.ps1`, `tools/patch.mjs` — the desktop edition.

Not affiliated with DeepSeek. The whale is fan art based on the DeepSeek logo; the crab is based on the Claude Code mascot.
